projects.title: Wind Turbo – The Portable Energy Generator
projects.description:
•	Designed a portable wind turbine that is capable of generating power
•	Focused the design on being environmentally sustainable by carefully choosing material
•	Go through testing indoor and outdoor: Prototype generated 8 V at 7 mph, expecting to generate 12 V in target market with an average wind speed of 15.4 mph
•	Researched on market pricing to ensure the product is also economically profitable: Prototype cost $85 but with market scaling, production pricing could be $24, raise the profit to be as much as 70%
•	Orchestrated through the whole project to ensure due dates and communicated effectively in team of 5; learned how to generate an engineering report for the product.
•	Project was showcased at 2017 ASEE Conference in Arizona, presented at 2017 IEEE conference in San Jose and received overall “A” grade in course.
